function.name: search_options
function.description: Find purchase options for the group. Results are ranked by Tandem's deterministic consensus engine; cite only the returned explanation_facts.

category.description: Catalog category: rental, passes, furniture, electronics, gift_bundle, flights, or any other buying category. Empty results mean no catalog offer; do not invent one.

budget_per_person_max.description: Maximum budget per person in USD dollars, NOT cents. For a $300 budget pass 300, never 30000. This is a search filter, not a spending authorization.

function.name: start_vote
function.description: Start a group vote between 2 to 4 option ids returned by search_options.

function.name: create_purchase
function.description: After a vote has a winner, open funding: creates per-member shares and sends private consent links. Does not charge anyone.

function.name: check_status
function.description: Get funding status (counts only, never individual budgets).

function.name: propose_fallback
function.description: When a member declines or drops, or price/deadline risk occurs, compute up to 3 fallbacks deterministically and post them for a vote.

function.name: add_expense
function.description: Record a shared expense paid by one member and split it.

function.name: publish_plan
function.description: Publish a separate shared website trip plan using a searched option. Use the organizer’s chosen option, or the top-ranked match when they request a proposed rough-plan link. No payments or fabricated members are created. The server attaches a private organizer link.

function.name: save_buying_brief
function.description: Record the CURRENT solo or group buying goal before searching. Replace old trip/gift requirements when the topic changes. Supports any category; one buyer is valid. Me and 4 friends means 5 total.

budget_per_person.description: Use when the user directly states a per-buyer budget, in USD dollars. For a combined budget use budget_total instead; the server calculates the per-buyer amount. Omit if unknown. A budget is not an offer or payment authorization.

budget_total.description: User-stated combined budget for the entire purchase, in USD dollars. The server divides this by group_size. Preserve the stated total rather than passing a derived amount as budget_per_person. Omit if the user only states a per-buyer budget.

group_size_evidence.description: Exact phrase from the source user message (latest by default, or source_message_seq) supporting the interpreted number of buyers. Use this for counts stated in words or relationships so the server can retain that count as confirmed without keyword-specific parsing. Do not include the recipient unless the user says they are paying.

recommendations.description: Qualitative options/tradeoffs only, no prices, URLs, availability, or claims of verified products.

decision_details.description: User-confirmed facts for this decision: travel origin/destination, dates, lodging, interests, or gift recipient, occasion, delivery deadline. Retain answered facts when updating.

open_questions.description: Only unanswered questions that materially affect this request. Remove answered questions. Do not ask about hotels for flight-only requests unless the user wants broader trip planning.

research_kinds.description: The research components the user actually needs. A full trip may need flight, stay and activity; a gift needs gift. Do not assume every trip needs flights.

plan_sections.description: Public agreed plan: useful itinerary, logistics, recipient preferences or decision rationale. Only confirmed facts or clearly labeled suggestions. No private data, invented prices, availability or URLs; source links are attached by server.

new_goal.description: True only when the user starts a DIFFERENT purchase. Defaults to partial update. Flights and lodging within a trip are the same goal. Never true for yes/no, a place name, count or budget answer.

source_message_seq.description: Sequence number of the user message that states this buying request. Use when recovering a new goal from an earlier message after follow-ups. Must refer to an actual inbound message in this chat, newer than the saved goal. Facts are checked against that message; do not cite unrelated older requests.

function.name: publish_buying_plan
function.description: Create a shared or solo planning-only frontend page from the current buying brief when no priced catalog option exists. No offer, payment, hold, or booking is fabricated.

featured_offer.description: Letter of a current live web result the user chose to feature. It stays planning-only: no checkout.

featured_offer_id.description: Exact offer_id from research_results for the chosen flight, stay, gift or other saved result; use this instead of an ambiguous letter across searches.

function.name: live_search
function.description: Search the live web for real listings, products, flights or activities when the demo catalog has nothing suitable or the user asks for real options. Results are public links with prices as listed, NOT quotes: they cannot be paid for in Tandem. Use specific queries.

query.description: Specific search, e.g. 'South Lake Tahoe cabin rental hot tub'.

budget_per_person_max.description: USD dollars, not cents. A filter, not a spending authorization.

route.description: Required for flight searches: confirmed origin and destination. Airport codes when known. Dates must be supplied separately; do not assume a fare matches those dates.

function.name: compare_options
function.description: Side-by-side comparison of current catalog options (by id) and/or live web results (by letter). The server writes the comparison; do not restate it.

function.name: remember_preference
function.description: Save durable preferences the user explicitly confirmed (e.g. 'vegetarian', 'prefers cabins with a hot tub', 'flies from SEA'). Not budgets, cards, phone numbers or one-off details. Use forget to remove one the user retracts.

function.name: present_recommendations
function.description: Present a curated shortlist from retrieved live results, across relevant research components. Select at most 3 actual products, properties or providers that best answer this request. Prefer direct purchasing/provider pages over social posts, news, broad directories or generic guides. If results are poor, refine the search first. Never invent features, prices, availability, or URLs. Select a supporting passage by its zero-based index in that offer’s evidence_choices. The server attaches that exact source text. Choose fewer than three if other results lack useful evidence of fit. Prefer passages about relevant capacity, location or features rather than boilerplate checkout policies. Never fill the shortlist just to reach three.

evidence_index.description: Index into this offer’s evidence_choices array. Choose the passage that best shows why it fits; do not invent source text.
